verdict.rationale: Elicit documents an official, first-party MCP server at https://elicit.com/api/mcp. It gives a concrete setup command for Claude Code and states that all API functionality is exposed to MCP-compatible clients such as Claude Desktop and Claude Code. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: claude mcp add --transport http elicit https://elicit.com/api/mcp
All API functionality is also available via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, enabling use from Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other MCP-compatible clients.
